subject: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout

Team —

As we scale into Q2 we have a cluster of new people managers (ICs promoted in the last 9 months) who are asking for practical coaching on performance conversations, roadmap-driven feedback, and how to have difficult but productive PIP-related discussions. Id like to pilot a short program focused on:

- Coaching for 1:1s and mid-cycle feedback
- Performance management frameworks and documentation hygiene
- Role-play for difficult conversations (underperformance, behavioral issues)
- Calibration prep and how to run a fair review cycle

Attached is a proposed agenda and a rough budget estimate for a vendor-led pilot (proposed_agenda.pdf, budget_estimate.xlsx). My asks:

1) Can People Ops greenlight an external partner to run a 2-half-day workshop + 1:1 coaching slots for up to 12 managers as a pilot?
2) Can HR confirm any non-negotiable clauses around recordings, notes retention, and coach NDAs?
3) Sales/platform teams (Alex) — can you help slot calendar space late March / early April if we move forward?

Suggested pilot window: week of Mar 22 or Mar 29 (flexible). Goal: equip new managers before the mid-year review cycle. If approved, Id like to contract a vendor and run a small pilot with managers from Product, Platform, and Solutions.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Carolyn Ng <carolyn@talentpartners.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Talent Partners <coaching@talentpartners.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout

Hi Laura —

Thanks for reaching out and for the clear brief. Talent Partners can absolutely design a compact pilot that covers hands-on role plays and 1:1 coaching. Quick summary of what we recommend:

- Deliverables: two interactive half-day workshops (live, virtual or in-person) + four 45-minute 1:1 coaching sessions per manager (bookable over 4 weeks)
- Approach: scenario-based role-play, live feedback, playbook templates for documentation and PIP checklists
- Pricing: pilot for up to 12 managers — $22,000 (workshops + 1:1 slots + materials).
- Timeline: we have availability week of Mar 22 and week of Apr 5.

Ive attached a first-draft SOW (TP_SOW_v1.pdf) and a sample agenda. To proceed wed need headcount (exact list of managers), preferred dates, and confirmation on recording/notes policy. Coaches who would run the sessions: myself and Daniel Ortiz (Senior Coach).

Happy to do a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Carolyn Ng
Principal Coach, Talent Partners
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout

+1 from me — this looks timely. A couple of practical notes from the manager side:

- Please include scenario work specifically about mid-perf contributors whove slipped after org changes (were seeing these after the Q4 reorg). Managers want language for redirecting vs. escalating to PIP.
- Role-play with recorded facilitator feedback (not shared beyond HR) would be very helpful; that said, record-keeping constraints should be observed.
- If we can do Mar 22 week, Id like Product and Platform managers prioritized. Ill pull a proposed attendee list and share by EOD Wed 2/18.

Alex — can you keep the afternoons free March 22-26 for workshop times?

Marissa
Head of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Talent Partners <coaching@talentpartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout

Carolyn / Talent Partners —

Thanks for the quick SOW. A few HR/legal guardrails we need included before contracting:

1) No session recording without explicit written consent from all attendees; any facilitator notes must be retained only by the coach in their private client notes and not uploaded to Redwood systems (we will provide a secure folder if notes are to be shared).
2) Coaches who will have access to manager names and performance context must sign our standard contractor NDA (Ill circulate the NDA).
3) Any training materials that reference employee-specific examples must be redacted or anonymized.

Ive attached our confidentiality summary and training-recording-policy for reference (confidentiality_guidelines.pdf, training-recording-policy.pdf). Also: please add a clause in the SOW that clarifies data deletion timelines for session notes and that no recordings will be used for research or marketing.

Separately, we plan a calibration panel in April; would you be open to a 60-min calibration facilitation session (cost TBD) so managers are aligned going into mid-year reviews?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of People Operations (Employee Relations)
Redwood Inference
From: Carolyn Ng <carolyn@talentpartners.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Talent Partners <coaching@talentpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: First-line leaders training: Performance conversations & coaching rollout

Hi Hannah / Laura / Marissa —

Thanks — we can accommodate all the HR guardrails. Changes made in TP_SOW_v1.1 (attached):

- Explicit non-recording clause and requirement for written consent if any recording is considered
- Coach NDA clause added; we will sign Redwoods NDA and confirm on execution
- Data retention: coach notes to be deleted 90 days after final 1:1 coaching session unless Redwood requests otherwise in writing

We are available week of Mar 22 for the workshops and can also facilitate the 60-min calibration panel the week of Apr 12 (titled: "Calibration: aligning manager assessments"). Next steps:

1) Please confirm final attendee list by EOD Thu 2/19
2) We will send an updated SOW + DocuSign link for signature (https://docusign.com/TP-SOW-Redwood-2026)
3) Upon SOW execution we will schedule workshop invites and coach 1:1 slots

Attached: TP_SOW_v1.1.pdf

Looking forward to partnering on this pilot.

Warmly,
Carolyn Ng
Principal Coach, Talent Partners
